mandate: Investigate American Rider as a scalable multimarket transportation and logistics platform. Generate and evaluate ideas and solutions, including but not limited to package/courier service, anticipatory/queued dispatch near current Travel completion, destination-aware matching, jurisdiction-by-configuration expansion, provider abstraction, and lower-cost/open-source/self-hosted mapping/routing/geocoding options. Inspect the exact current product before proposing duplication. Seek additional non-obvious ideas. Optimize for safety, service quality, first-class hospitality, operator/traveler value, simplicity, scalability, reliability, legal/regulatory configurability, and sustainable unit economics. Distinguish evidence, idea, recommendation, experiment, and authorized implementation.
selectionPolicy: Establish the relevant whole-platform universe before optional specialist selection. Mandatory agents always run. Optional agents may be omitted only with an explicit non-applicability rationale. The Supervisor independently challenges omissions. Generate plural alternatives and do not converge before comparing cost, scalability, safety, service, operational burden, provider lock-in, jurisdictional consequences, and failure modes. Do not implement product changes without explicit human authorization.
